12 Entry Points

Supply Chain

NHS Supply Chain

National procurement hub managing category management, demand aggregation, and catalogue operations across NHS trusts. Centralises spend visibility, contract leverage, and supply resilience for 230+ NHS organisations. Covers £8bn+ annual spend across food, clinical consumables, capital medical equipment, and logistics services.

Clinical

Clinical Procurement

Medical devices, PPE, and consumables procurement with clinical preference evaluation. Covers MHRA registration, MDR/IVDR compliance, and product standardisation across acute and community settings.

Digital

Digital Procurement

NHS IT systems procurement including EPR, PACS, and digital clinical solutions via CCS frameworks. Accelerates trust-level digital maturity through standardised procurement routes and interoperability requirements.

Pharma

Pharmaceutical

NHS medicines procurement through NICE technology appraisals, biosimilar switching programmes, and managed entry agreements. Balances cost optimisation with clinical efficacy and patient access timelines. Manages £18bn+ annual medicines spend with complex pricing and rebate structures.

Estates

Estates & Facilities

NHS property management including PFI handback, energy procurement, FM contracts, and New Hospital Programme construction. Drives Net Zero targets through green energy sourcing and sustainable building standards. Manages £9bn+ estate with 1,400+ NHS sites requiring decarbonisation and modernisation.

Commissioning

Commissioning

ICB-level procurement for elective recovery, community services, and specialised commissioning. Aligns commissioning decisions with integrated care strategies, population health outcomes, and financial sustainability.

Capital

Capital Investment

New Hospital Programme, diagnostics expansion, elective surgical hubs, and community diagnostic centres. Coordinates multi-billion capital pipeline with construction procurement, equipment sourcing, and operational readiness.

Governance

Procurement Governance

PCR 2015 compliance, Social Value Act obligations, transparency requirements, and contract lifecycle management. Ensures every procurement route meets legal thresholds and audit-readiness standards.

Counter Fraud

Fraud & Corruption

NHS Counter Fraud Authority oversight of procurement fraud, conflicts of interest, and financial irregularity. Monitors bid-rigging, cartel behaviour, and supplier integrity across NHS supply chains.

Net Zero

Sustainability

NHS Net Zero 2040 commitment driving carbon footprint measurement, green procurement standards, and social value maximisation. Embeds environmental impact scoring into supplier selection and contract award criteria.

Workforce

Workforce Procurement

Agency staffing, locum procurement, framework compliance, and rate capping enforcement. Addresses NHS workforce supply challenges while controlling temporary staffing spend across trusts and ICBs. Agency spend exceeds £3bn annually with significant rate variation and compliance gaps.

Parliamentary

Parliamentary

DHSC accounting officer responsibilities, NAO value-for-money audits, PAC hearings, and annual accounts scrutiny. Provides parliamentary assurance on NHS procurement efficiency and taxpayer value. Subject to regular Select Committee inquiry and ministerial accountability framework.

8 Transformation Priorities

Priority 01

NHS Supply Chain Intelligence

AI-driven demand forecasting and procurement cycle acceleration from 12 weeks to 4 weeks. Category-level spend analytics and supplier risk scoring across NHS Supply Chain operations. Target: forecasting accuracy >90%, cycle time -67%.

Priority 02

Clinical Device Risk Assessment

Automated MDR/IVDR compliance monitoring and MHRA registration verification for all clinical devices. Real-time recall detection and cross-trust impact analysis. Target: MDR compliance 100%, recall response 48h→4h.

Priority 03

Pharmaceutical Cost Optimiser

Biosimilar switching intelligence and managed entry agreement tracking. NICE TA compliance monitoring with automated patient access scheme verification. Target: biosimilar uptake +30%, managed entry tracking automated.

Priority 04

NHS Digital Procurement Accelerator

Streamlined IT procurement through CCS framework intelligence and interoperability scoring. Automated EPR/PACS evaluation against NHS digital maturity requirements. Target: IT procurement 6mo→8wk, framework compliance 100%.

Priority 05

Estates Carbon Dashboard

Real-time NHS carbon footprint tracking across estates, energy, and construction procurement. Green procurement compliance scoring with Net Zero pathway alignment. Target: carbon tracking real-time, green compliance >85%.

Priority 06

Counter Fraud Intelligence

Procurement fraud detection using anomaly detection across bid patterns, pricing, and supplier networks. Automated conflicts of interest screening for all procurement officers. Target: fraud detection +70%, CoI screening automated.

Priority 07

Agency Staffing Optimiser

Intelligent agency spend management with framework compliance enforcement and rate cap monitoring. Trust-level demand forecasting for temporary workforce needs. Target: agency spend -25%, framework compliance 60%→95%.

Priority 08

Contract Performance Monitor

Automated KPI tracking across all NHS procurement contracts with predictive underperformance alerts. Supplier relationship scoring and escalation triggers. Target: KPI tracking 100% automated, alert within 48h of underperformance.

🔴 6 Sovereign Red Lines

  • 1. PCR 2015 Compliance — No NHS procurement contract awarded without compliant process; all require competitive procedure or justified direct award with published VE notice.
  • 2. Device Registration — No clinical device procured without MHRA registration and MDR/IVDR compliance verification.
  • 3. Patient Data Protection — No patient data accessed for procurement analytics without DPIA and Caldicott Guardian approval.
  • 4. NICE TA Authority — No pharmaceutical contract bypassing NICE technology appraisal without DHSC ministerial override.
  • 5. Rate Cap Authority — No agency staffing rate set above framework cap without ICB-level finance director written approval.
  • 6. Human Decision Gate — No NHS procurement decision made solely by algorithm; all awards above £100K require human evaluation panel.

5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery
Map NHS procurement landscape, stakeholder requirements, regulatory obligations, and existing digital maturity across target trusts and ICBs.
2
Governance Design
Establish AI governance framework aligned with PCR 2015, EU AI Act Article 50, and NHS-specific oversight requirements including Caldicott and SIRO roles.
3
Pilot
Deploy controlled pilot across selected procurement category with full audit trail, human oversight gates, and measurable outcome KPIs.
4
Scale
Expand validated AI capabilities across procurement categories, trusts, and ICBs with federated governance and continuous monitoring.
5
Assure
Ongoing compliance assurance, performance benchmarking, red line audit, and Article 50 conformity assessment with quarterly governance reviews.
